description: Send a question the property record and FAQ don't answer. The answer arrives later; tell the guest you'll follow up. Don't include the guest's contact details. Maps to POST /v1/properties/{id}/questions.

property_id.description: The property the question is about.

question.description: The guest's question, in plain words, up to 500 characters. The host's answer may be added to the listing's FAQ.

name: ask_host

outputSchema.description: The question as passed to the host, and an answer if the listing already has one.

title: Ask the host a question
